metadata.title: Ethereal Sky Portrait with Decorative Fan

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait featuring a subject partially obscured by a decorative fan against a vast, saturated blue sky with prismatic lens flares.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a woman with dark hair, positioned on the right side of the frame, holding a bright coral-pink lace fan that covers the lower half of her face. The background is a solid, vibrant cerulean blue sky. Thin, prismatic light streaks and lens flares cut across the composition diagonally. The lighting is warm and soft, suggesting late afternoon sun.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center against a minimalist sky
Coral fan providing a warm contrast to the cool blue background
Diagonal lens flares connecting the subject to the negative space
Typography anchored in the upper-left quadrant for balance
coreInvariants: Subject partially obscured by a handheld prop
Prismatic light leak or flare effects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is medium-close-up, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright coral fan acts as the primary focal point due to its color and central placement relative to the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's gaze, move down to the fan, then follow the lens flares toward the typography in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the upper and left portions of the frame, filled with a uniform blue gradient.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in both the sky and the fan, with high value in the skin tones and flares.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high saturation in the blues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast within the same geometric family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric structure and clean monolinear strokes.
Open-source alternative with similar geometric proportions.
Classic geometric sans that captures the clean, modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman with dark hair on the right side of the frame, holding a coral-pink lace fan over her mouth. The background is a clear, saturated cerulean blue sky. Add thin, diagonal prismatic light flares across the image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of white, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the upper left corner. The top line should be bold with wide tracking; the bottom line should be regular weight with extra-wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the sky a vibrant, saturated blue?
Is the text left-aligned in the upper-left quadrant?
Are there prismatic lens flares present?
Is the fan a contrasting coral or warm pink tone?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or album titles
Do not replicate the exact lace pattern of the fan
Do not copy the exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the blue background
Check that lens flares do not obscure the subject's eyes
Verify the color balance between the cool sky and warm fan
Confirm the wide tracking is consistent across both lines of text
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Saturated Sky + Prop Obscuration + Geometric Sans-Serif + Prismatic Flares
